subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should Feishu expose the permanent channels.feishu.sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs setting, including per-account overrides, as the supported pacing policy?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration, and code review cannot decide whether operators should tune pacing or whether the plugin should own an automatic policy.

options.title: Approve the opt-in setting
options.body: Accept the zero-default configuration surface after live Feishu proof and the metadata and documentation defects are fixed.

options.title: Use automatic pacing
options.body: Replace the public setting with plugin-owned pacing derived from a maintainer-approved Feishu quota policy or server feedback.

options.title: Retain retry only
options.body: Decline proactive pacing and continue relying on the existing bounded rate-limit retry behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Accept the zero-default configuration surface after live Feishu proof and the metadata and documentation defects are fixed.
